authority: owner-issued only; the executor may propose an entry with status 'proposed' but never activates a release
policy_note: Active release registry for canonical graph-write authority. Exactly one entry may carry status 'active'. Each entry's entry_hash is sha256 over the canonical JSON serialization of the entry WITHOUT the entry_hash field itself. The loader fails closed on any ambiguity; a fail-closed resolution is equivalent to no active release, and deny-by-default graph_write_allowed then refuses every canonical graph write. ReleaseStamp and TemporalEnvelope payloads are descriptive identity and can never be consumed as write authority.
